title: Harsh Spanish Turkey Tagine
description: A spicy, pungent Spanish turkey tagine that melts in a banana leaf, perfect for adventurous diners.
instructions: Preheat the tagine or oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Fold the banana leaf into a square, wet it slightly to make it pliable, and place it in the bottom of the tagine.
Rub the turkey thighs with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper and let them rest for 10 minutes.
Sauté the onion, bell pepper, and carrot in the tagine until softened, about five minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and stir for two minutes.
Place the seasoned turkey on top of the vegetables and pour in the chicken broth.
Cover the tagine with its lid and seal the banana leaf around the edges.
Cook for 70 minutes until the turkey is tender and the juices have thickened.
Remove the tagine from heat, let it rest for five minutes, then carefully transfer the contents onto a serving platter.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
